newsitem.title: UK: CORTECS SHARES UP 10 PCT ON MACRITONIN PLANS.
newsitem.headline: CORTECS SHARES UP 10 PCT ON MACRITONIN PLANS.

text.p: Shares in Cortecs International Ltd hit a three-week high on Thursday after announcing plans to register Macritonin, an oral version of an anti-bone-wasting drug, in Europe by the end of this month, traders said.
By 0816 GMT, Cortecs shares were up 17-1/2p at 180p, after hitting a session high of 193p.
The Anglo-Australian drug company said analysis of a double-blind European Phase II/III on Macritonin had confirmed initial positive results announced in May.
Cortecs said it had received approaches from a number of potential marketing partners and aimed to begin U.S. clinical trials on Macritonin in the fourth quarter.
An article in the Financial Times on Thursday outlining Cortecs' plans also gave an early boost to the shares, traders said.
